prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create one premium, deeply photorealistic editorial product photograph of a beautiful handcrafted hardcover book for the SIERRA documentary book collection. This is a proposed physical edition, no decorative graphic outside the book. Square photograph, entire book fully visible with generous breathing space, standing at a subtle three-quarter angle so the front cover is dominant and very readable, spine and thick ivory uncoated paper edges visible. Matte woven bookcloth, fine natural fibers, subtle pressed black/stone ink, sewn binding, tactile artisanal construction. Soft oblique natural studio light, warm stone seamless background and stone surface, restrained believable shadow, calm literary presence, organic raw elegant minimalism. No shiny foil, no glossy plastic, no ribbons/flowers/random props, no frame, no watermark, no price, no fake publisher/ISBN/date. Reference 1 is the SIERRA brand manual: use its raw hand-cut letterpress display-letter style (SIERRA CF) for the title, its small American Typewriter secondary type for the author. Never use classical Baskerville/Cochin/Didot book typography. The original SIERRA wordmark and the small original signature underneath it are one indivisible mark; if used reproduce it exactly, small near the bottom of the front cover. Use only the exact supplied original illustration, preserve its shape, linework and proportions; DO NOT redraw, reinterpret or add illustrations. The illustration must not collide with text. Original illustration inputs may have black ink on transparent background, treat the alpha correctly. Book format: HORIZONTAL landscape hardcover photo book, A4 landscape proportions 29.7 cm wide x21 cm high, approximately 2 cm thick. Cover: pale stone-gray natural linen, black pigment. Exact title in two confident hand-cut display lines near top left: 'Detrás de' then 'la tranquera'. Exact author below title in small typewriter: 'Juan F. Montes'. Reference 2 is the exact original rustic wooden gate illustration; place it fully visible across the lower right portion, large but airy, preserving every original line. Small intact SIERRA mark near bottom left, separate from illustration, exact signature 'UN DOCUMENTAL DE JUAN F. MONTES'. No extra subtitle. Quiet documentary photographer's field-book feeling. Photograph a closed horizontal book resting flat at a shallow three-quarter angle viewed from a slightly elevated camera so the complete cover remains dominant and easily legible. No crop.
